instance_type: <str> Type of set function instance, one of LOC (Facility Location), COV (Weighted Coverage), or INF (Bipartite Influence).
n: <int> Number of candidate elements (facility sites, sensors, or influence sources) in the ground set.
m: <int> Number of auxiliary entities (clients, items, or targets) used to evaluate the set function.
k: <int> Maximum number of elements that may be selected.
gamma: <float> Upper bound on the submodular ratio of the set function, used to scale marginal gains in the selection constraints.
type_specific_param: <float> Generation parameter specific to the instance type (coverage probability for COV, edge probability for INF, unused for LOC).
data_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [m][n]> Benefit, coverage indicator, or edge indicator between each auxiliary entity and each candidate element, depending on instance type.
node_weights: <list[float], length m> Weight of each auxiliary entity (used for item importance in COV instances, zero otherwise).
element_weights: <list[float], length n> Activation probability of each candidate element (used for influence computation in INF instances, zero otherwise).
